health.sub: Which services this dashboard needs, and which are up right now.

bridge.name: ICONICS bridge
bridge.ok: The plant server is reachable and the token is valid.
bridge.degraded: ICONICS is reachable but there is NO valid token: reads will go out unauthenticated. Check ICONICS_USERNAME / ICONICS_PASSWORD and that user's permissions.

health.title: System health
health.loadFailed: {{error}}. If this screen will not load, the problem is not one view: it is the server itself. Check that the backend is running and that it can be reached over the network.
health.footer: Reread every {{segundos}} s. A «not configured» service is not a fault: it is an installation that does not have it.

detail.fake: ICONICS_FAKE=true: the simulator generates every value. NO data is real.
detail.noToken: {{donde}} is reachable but there is no valid token: reads would go out unauthenticated. Check ICONICS_USERNAME / ICONICS_PASSWORD and that user’s permissions.
detail.readFailed: {{donde}} is reachable and the token is valid, but the last read —{{desde}} s ago— FAILED: {{motivo}}. Answering is not delivering.
detail.needsReauth: {{donde}} is reachable, but it is asking for RE-AUTHENTICATION: the session expired on the ICONICS side and for the last {{desde}} s it has been returning the login page instead of data. The token the bridge holds looks valid because its expiry has not arrived yet, but the server no longer accepts it. Restarting the bridge fixes it.
detail.neverRead: {{donde}} is reachable and the token is valid. No live reading has been requested yet since the bridge started.
detail.noValues_one: {{donde}} is reachable and the token is valid, but the last read ({{segundos}} s ago) brought back NOT A SINGLE value out of the 1 point requested.
detail.noValues_other: {{donde}} is reachable and the token is valid, but the last read ({{segundos}} s ago) brought back NOT A SINGLE value out of the {{count}} points requested.
detail.partial_one: Real readings from {{donde}}, but incomplete: of the 1 point requested {{segundos}} s ago, {{conValor}} came back with a value and {{conCalidadBuena}} with acceptable quality.
detail.partial_other: Real readings from {{donde}}, but incomplete: of the {{count}} points requested {{segundos}} s ago, {{conValor}} came back with a value and {{conCalidadBuena}} with acceptable quality.
detail.complete: Real readings from {{donde}}. The last one, {{segundos}} s ago: {{conValor}}/{{puntosPedidos}} points with a value and good quality.
detail.assistantNotConfigured: The chat responds 503 and the dashboard works the same.
detail.docsNotLoadedYet: The index loads on the first search; none has been requested yet.

access.title: Dashboard access
access.subtitle: This server requires a session. Sign in with your credentials.
access.renewalFailedWall: The session could not be renewed. Data may fall behind.
